clue.text: Add a very quiet coda

parts.note: pp, pianissimo, is the musical marking for very quiet
a coda is the closing section, the end of a piece

explanation.surface: A composer is told to tack a hushed closing passage onto a piece.
explanation.definitionFit: To append something is to attach it at the end, a straight synonym of add.

clue.text: Someone being inquisitive about boy who's inside?

indicators.note: about means the inquisitive person goes around the word for boy

parts.note: a prier is one who pries, a nosy person
a son is a boy

explanation.surface: A nosy person snoops about a lad who has been locked up.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone held in jail is inside, in slang, so a captive inmate.

clue.text: Competition I had entered, initially, late in the day

parts.note: an event is a competition in a sports meeting
I had contracts to I'd, written without its apostrophe

indicators.note: initially takes the first letter of the word entered

explanation.surface: Someone enters a competition only just in time, late on.
explanation.definitionFit: Eventide is a poetic word for evening, the late part of the day.

clue.text: Falsify badly how to make a TV series

parts.note: to doctor accounts is to falsify them

indicators.note: badly means the letters of how are jumbled

explanation.surface: Instructions for cooking up a TV show by faking things clumsily.
explanation.definitionFit: The long-running BBC science-fiction programme about a time-travelling alien is a famous TV series.

clue.text: It facilitates aim of multinational group, in good sense

indicators.note: in places the international body inside the pair of words standing for good and sense

parts.note: sight is one of the five senses
the UN, the United Nations, is a multinational organisation

explanation.surface: A diplomatic remark that an international body's goals are sensible.
explanation.walkthrough: 'aim' reads as a goal of the UN, but here it is the aiming of a gun.
explanation.definitionFit: A device mounted on a firearm helps the shooter line up the target, so it assists aiming.

clue.text: Bedside table, for example?

parts.note: reads as a bedroom table, but a table set beside a flower bed outdoors is the kind of furniture meant

explanation.definitionFit: Tables and chairs used outdoors beside flower beds are the furniture of a garden.

clue.text: Salesman's patter about a new dog

indicators.note: about means the patter word goes around the other letters

parts.note: a spiel is a glib sales pitch

explanation.surface: A salesman gives his pitch about a new puppy.
explanation.definitionFit: A spaniel is a breed of dog with long ears.

clue.text: Aggressive type, one who understands Asian game?

parts.note: go is a board game from East Asia
to get something is to understand it, so a getter understands

explanation.surface: A pushy person is someone who has mastered an Eastern game.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue reads as one who 'gets' Go; the pieces join in answer order with the game first.
explanation.definitionFit: A go-getter is a pushy, ambitious person, aggressive in pursuing success.

clue.text: Finish one line in essay in modern style

indicators.note: in puts the three pieces inside the word for essay

parts.note: an essay is an attempt, a try
to end is to finish
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Advice to end a school essay with a fashionable line.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something trendily is doing it fashionably, in a modern style.

clue.text: This reduces the effect of exhaustion, from what we hear

definitions.text: This reduces the effect of exhaustion, from what we hear

parts.words: This reduces the effect of exhaustion, from what we hear
parts.note: reads like something that eases tiredness, but exhaustion here is a car's exhaust, whose noise a fitted device muffles for our ears

explanation.surface: Something that seems to relieve fatigue, according to rumour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exhaustion' suggests tiredness; it is the exhaust system, and 'from what we hear' is about noise, not hearsay.
explanation.definitionFit: A muffler fitted to an exhaust pipe cuts the noise it makes, which is what this device does.

clue.text: Manipulate wide difference between inclinations

parts.note: W is the cricket scorer's abbreviation for a wide
an angle measures how far two lines' slopes differ

explanation.surface: Someone is told to exploit a big gap between people's preferences.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inclinations' suggests preferences; here they are slopes, and the gap between two is an angle.
explanation.definitionFit: To wangle is to get something by crafty manipulation or contrivance.

clue.text: Pay with one kind of money for addition to manuscript

parts.note: to foot the bill is to pay it
a banknote is paper money, as opposed to coins

explanation.surface: Someone settles up with paper money for an extra bit added to a document.
explanation.definitionFit: A note set at the foot of a page is an addition to the main text of a manuscript.

clue.text: Presented as especially intelligent

definitions.meaning: having exceptional natural talent or brains

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: something handed over as a present, and a child of exceptional ability.

clue.text: Ruin season with county as opener

indicators.note: as opener puts the county word first, before the season

parts.note: Down is a county of Northern Ireland
fall is the American word for autumn

explanation.surface: A cricket season is wrecked when a county side sends in the opening batsman.
explanation.walkthrough: County Down is in Northern Ireland; 'opener' sounds like cricket but just says which piece leads.
explanation.definitionFit: A downfall is a collapse or undoing, so it means ruin as a noun.

clue.text: Scotsman, kind of, producing illegal punch?

parts.note: a low blow, below the belt, is illegal in boxing
a lander is a punch that lands on target

explanation.surface: A Scot of some sort throws a foul punch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'producing' is a link; the clue reads as someone landing a low punch.
explanation.definitionFit: A person from the southern and eastern lowland region of Scotland is one kind of Scotsman.

clue.text: Odds of torturer being right

indicators.note: odds of takes the first, third, fifth and seventh letters of the next word

explanation.surface: A grim remark that a torturer might somehow be in the right.
explanation.definitionFit: True and right are synonyms, as in a correct or accurate answer.

clue.text: Refined and adjusted set with fault

indicators.note: adjusted means the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A machine part was refined and reset despite a defect.
explanation.definitionFit: Tasteful means showing good taste, so refined in manner or style.

clue.text: Bishop, in foreign article, willingly revealing lack of faith

indicators.note: in places the bishop's letter inside the foreign word

parts.note: une is the French indefinite article
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
lief is an old word meaning gladly, willingly

explanation.surface: A bishop happily tells a foreign paper he has lost his faith.
explanation.walkthrough: 'article' suggests a newspaper piece; it is the grammatical article, French une.
explanation.definitionFit: Unbelief is the absence of religious faith, disbelief.

clue.text: Suffer defending right to follow religious practice

indicators.note: defending means the word for suffer surrounds and protects the letter for right

parts.note: to pay for something is to suffer for it

explanation.surface: Believers are persecuted for upholding their freedom of worship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Suffer' wants to be the definition; it is the outer piece, and the definition is at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: To pray is a central act of worship, so it is following religious practice.

clue.text: In period before court case, not left holding zero capital

indicators.note: holding means the shortened word takes the zero inside it
not means the left letter is dropped

parts.note: pretrial is the stage before a court hearing
O looks like zero

explanation.surface: Before trial, a defendant with nothing left is held in custody.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In' is a link word; 'capital' is the definition, a city.
explanation.definitionFit: Pretoria is South Africa's administrative capital city.

clue.text: Primarily, one delivery subsuming almost half a dozen

parts.note: A means one

indicators.note: subsuming means the delivery word contains the shortened piece

parts.note: a ball is a delivery from the bowler in cricket
an over in cricket is six balls, half a dozen

explanation.surface: A cricket delivery that seems to contain nearly six balls.
explanation.walkthrough: An over in cricket is six balls bowled in a row; 'almost' cuts it to OVE.
explanation.definitionFit: Above all means chiefly, most importantly, which is primarily.

clue.text: Author needing royalty as one temporarily in debt

parts.note: George Borrow was a 19th-century English writer
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the royal cipher

explanation.surface: A writer relies on royalty payments while short of money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'royalty' looks like an author's earnings; it is ER, the Queen. George Borrow wrote Lavengro.
explanation.definitionFit: A borrower takes a loan and owes it until repaying, so is temporarily in debt.

clue.text: His life was that of a self-styled harmless drudge

definitions.text: His life was that of a self-styled harmless drudge

parts.words: His life was that of a self-styled harmless drudge
parts.note: Samuel Johnson defined a lexicographer as a harmless drudge, so this names the man who wrote Johnson's celebrated Life

explanation.walkthrough: 'His life' sounds like the man's own life; it is the biography he wrote, the Life of Samuel Johnson.
explanation.definitionFit: James Boswell wrote the famous biography of Samuel Johnson, the dictionary-maker.

clue.text: Person in good faith putting end to daylight robbery

indicators.note: end to takes the final letter of the word daylight

parts.note: a heist is a robbery

explanation.surface: An honest person halts a brazen robbery in broad daylight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'good faith' sounds like honesty; it is religious belief.
explanation.definitionFit: A believer in God is a person of religious faith.

clue.text: Lethargic during performance I have shortened

parts.note: in, as in 'in the night', means during
an act is a performance on stage
I have contracted is I've, written without its apostrophe

explanation.surface: An actor admits to sluggishness during a show they cut short.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone lethargic is sluggish and does little, so is inactive.

clue.text: More than just showing beauty queen

parts.note: fair means good-looking, showing beauty
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the Queen

explanation.surface: A pageant contestant is praised as above mere justice.
explanation.definitionFit: Fairer is the comparative of fair in its sense of just, so more just than another.

clue.text: Have drastically reduced workforce as part of sounder management

indicators.note: part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Severe staff cuts are presented as a sign of more prudent leadership.
explanation.definitionFit: To be undermanned is to have too few staff, a workforce cut too far.

clue.text: Means of escape on hand for fortune-teller

definitions.meaning: a rope or route that rescues someone from danger
a crease on the palm a palmist reads as how long one will live

explanation.definitionFit: Both a rescue rope and the palmist's crease on the hand that foretells length of life share this name.

clue.text: Regroup with added energy, in fact

indicators.note: with added puts the energy letter into the word for regroup

parts.note: troops rally when they regroup after a setback
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A team pulls together with renewed vigour, as it happens.
explanation.definitionFit: Really and in fact both mean actually, as adverbs stressing truth.
